method: Annualized realized volatility of the pool's price ratio (token1 per token0): daily log-return standard deviation × √365 over GeckoTerminal OHLCV 2026-03-01 → 2026-08-31 (ETH/BTC ratio: hourly/daily blend). The IL-drag model is drag(σ, w) = −100·(1 − exp(−σ²/(4·f(w)))), validated by scripts/lp-sim.py Monte Carlo on every run. A pool ABSENT from `pools` has no σ and the gate refuses it with `no_volatility_input` — never a default.
